mapper.select: SELECT t.id,t.name,t.assessment_id assessmentId FROM training t ORDER BY t.id DESC
SELECT id,name FROM training WHERE created_by=#{owner} ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT DISTINCT a.department_id id,a.department_name name FROM training_audience a JOIN training t ON t.id=a.training_id WHERE t.created_by=#{owner} ORDER BY a.department_name

SELECT t.id trainingId,t.name trainingName,t.assessment_id assessmentId,t.end_at trainingEnd, ta.employee_id employeeId,ta.candidate_name name,ta.phone,ta.department_id departmentId,ta.department_name departmentName, s.id sessionId,s.started_at startedAt,s.completed_at confirmedAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM training_video v WHERE v.training_id=t.id) +(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM training_material m JOIN training_material_page p ON p.material_id=m.id WHERE m.training_id=t.id) totalUnits, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM candidate_video_progress p JOIN training_video v ON v.id=p.video_id WHERE v.training_id=t.id AND p.session_id=s.id AND p.completed=1) +(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM candidate_material_progress p JOIN training_material m ON m.id=p.material_id WHERE m.training_id=t.id AND p.session_id=s.id AND p.completed=1) completedUnits, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.studied_seconds) FROM candidate_video_progress p JOIN training_video v ON v.id=p.video_id WHERE v.training_id=t.id AND p.session_id=s.id),0) +COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.studied_seconds) FROM candidate_material_progress p JOIN training_material m ON m.id=p.material_id WHERE m.training_id=t.id AND p.session_id=s.id),0) studiedSeconds, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM candidate_video_progress p JOIN training_video v ON v.id=p.video_id WHERE v.training_id=t.id AND p.session_id=s.id AND p.studied_seconds IS NULL) missingDuration, (SELECT MAX(p.completed_at) FROM candidate_video_progress p JOIN training_video v ON v.id=p.video_id WHERE v.training_id=t.id AND p.session_id=s.id) videoCompletedAt, (SELECT MAX(p.completed_at) FROM candidate_material_progress p JOIN training_material m ON m.id=p.material_id WHERE m.training_id=t.id AND p.session_id=s.id) readingCompletedAt, a.end_at examEnd,a.name examName, aa.id attemptId,aa.status attemptStatus,aa.score,aa.total_score totalScore,aa.passed,aa.submitted_at submittedAt, CASE WHEN aa.submitted_at IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(0,TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,aa.started_at,aa.submitted_at)) END durationSeconds, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assessment_attempt x JOIN assessment_participant p ON p.id=x.participant_id WHERE p.task_id=a.id AND p.employee_id=ta.employee_id) attemptCount FROM training t JOIN training_audience ta ON ta.training_id=t.id LEFT JOIN assessment_task a ON a.id=t.assessment_id AND a.created_by=t.created_by LEFT JOIN candidate_learning_session s ON s.id=(SELECT MAX(x.id) FROM candidate_learning_session x WHERE x.employee_id=ta.employee_id AND (x.training_id=t.id OR x.task_id=t.assessment_id)) LEFT JOIN assessment_attempt aa ON aa.id=(SELECT MAX(x.id) FROM assessment_attempt x JOIN assessment_participant p ON p.id=x.participant_id WHERE p.task_id=a.id AND p.employee_id=ta.employee_id)
AND ta.department_id=#{filters.departmentId} ORDER BY t.id DESC,ta.employee_id
